integrity: The proof uses exact determinants, the directed matrix-tree theorem and BEST, with an independently replayable finite-check program; finite checks are corroboration, not the proof.
scientific_limitations: One primitive length-three orbit only, labeled alphabet, positional rotations only; full priority not independently certified. The first source was publicly posted on 2009-04-25; later papers are supporting context.
title: Exact universal-cycle counts after deleting one primitive length-three necklace
